title: Noah's excuses: carpenters' union strike, still no owls
summary: Continues the humorous modern-Noah story: the carpenters form a union and strike, Noah negotiates a settlement with the National Labor Relations Board, and now has 16 carpenters on the Ark but still no owls.

text.text: The carpenters formed a union and went out on strike. I had to negotiate a settlement with the National Labor Relations Board before anyone would pick up a saw or a hammer.
Now I have 16 carpenters on the Ark, but still no owls.

numbers.note: carpenters now working on the Ark in the joke
